The '''M4-T3 Astromech Droid''' was a model of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that was used for various tasks at [[Sobrik Spaceport]], the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], while the city was under [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] rule.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
M4-T3 Astromech Droids appear as friendly characters in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found in Sobrik Spaceport in the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
